seoTitle: How to Remove Jotform Branding From Your Site
metaDescription: Learn how to turn off the Powered by Jotform footer in 2026 through your account settings, for a clean, white-label form experience.
intro: The default Powered by Jotform footer can undercut a polished, custom-branded site, and removing it just takes a setting change in your account. This guide covers finding the branding toggle in your settings, disabling it, and confirming it's gone from both live forms and confirmation emails.

steps.heading: Open your Account Settings
steps.body: Click your profile avatar icon and select Settings from the dropdown account menu.

steps.heading: Find the Jotform Branding section
steps.body: Scroll down within the settings tab to locate the Jotform Branding options.

steps.heading: Uncheck the promotional footer option
steps.body: Uncheck the "Show Powered by Jotform on My Forms" box to remove the tag from your account.

steps.heading: Check account tier requirements
steps.body: Review whether your current plan tier fully supports removing promotional brand elements, since this can depend on your subscription level.

steps.heading: Verify across live and embedded forms
steps.body: Test your form builder canvas footer preview, then refresh your website's embedded form layout to confirm the branding is gone everywhere.

faq.question: Is removing Jotform branding available on the free plan?
faq.answer: Removing the branding footer is often tied to a paid account tier, so check your plan's requirements before assuming it's available.

faq.question: Does this also remove branding from confirmation emails?
faq.answer: Yes, the branding setting is designed to clear promotional tags from both your live forms and automated confirmation emails.

faq.question: Will removing branding affect an already-embedded form on WordPress?
faq.answer: You may need to refresh your WordPress or website embed frame after making the change for the unbranded version to display.

faq.question: Can I remove branding from individual forms only?
faq.answer: The branding toggle is typically an account-wide setting rather than something adjusted per individual form.
